run_robustness_test: run a robustness test on a detection model with specified corruptions and severity levels
test_detector_with_corruptions: test a detector model against image corruptions like noise, blur, weather, and digital artifacts
evaluate_model_robustness_benchmark: evaluate model robustness using the ImageNet-C benchmark corruption categories across severity levels 0 to 5
parse_args_corruption_options: parse command line arguments for corruption types, severity levels, and output options for robustness testing
dump_aggregated_results: dump aggregated evaluation results to a pickle file for offline analysis and metric computation
